intent: TEST for ReactorTelemetryStreamGateway at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/broadcasting/infrastructure/ReactorTelemetryStreamGateway.java. JUnit 5 + AssertJ (+ Mockito, reactor-test StepVerifier for reactive code); cover every invariant and behavior below, including failure cases, using only the pinned surfaces of collaborators. Unit under test: Telemetry Stream Broadcasting adapter implementing TelemetryStreamGateway. Constructor ReactorTelemetryStreamGateway(int subscriberBuffer>0). Backed by Sinks.many().multicast().directBestEffort(); publish emits non-blocking (no subscribers or slow subscribers never block or fail the publisher); items() = sink.asFlux().onBackpressureBuffer(subscriberBuffer, BufferOverflowStrategy.DROP_OLDEST) so each subscriber's demand is respected with bounded memory.
